title: Staged Private Rollouts: Roadmap, OKRs, and Operational Guardrails
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Background: Enterprise customers are asking for predictable, low-risk private/VPC/on-prem upgrades with observability and rollback guardrails. This ticket defines a staged rollout roadmap for Q2 to 1) reduce upgrade failures, 2) surface clear OKRs for success, and 3) provide operational runbooks + preflight checks for Dedicated and Private customers.

Scope: Roadmap and measurable OKRs across pilot -> limited alpha -> beta -> GA for private deployments. Includes gating criteria, preflight automation checklist, rollback policy, and cross-functional sign-offs (Infra, Security, Solutions, Customer Success). Excludes changes to model runtime kernels (handled in ENG roadmap) but will include config defaults and deployment orchestration rules.

Goal: Deliver an operationalized, repeatable rollout pathway that cuts private deployment MTTD/MTTR by >=30% and reduces post-upgrade incidents by 50% versus baseline.
acceptance_criteria: A staged release schedule is published with dates, cohorts, and gating criteria
Preflight check automation (config/compatibility/smoke tests) defined and implemented for pilot customers
Runbook with clear rollback and escalation paths published in Confluence and reviewed by Security and Infra
OKRs and success metrics are defined, instrumented in dashboards, and baseline established
At least two pilot customers signed up and a dry-run executed in a dedicated staging environment
success_metrics: Baseline MTTD for private deploy regressions established (target: 30% reduction)
Post-deploy incident rate per deployment (target: <0.2 incidents/deploy at GA)
Median time-to-rollback for failed upgrades (target: <15 minutes after detection)
Customer satisfaction NPS change for Private customers after rollout (target: +5)
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal dry-run (2026-03-20) — validate preflight checks and rollback automation. Phase 1: Pilot cohort (2 customers) 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15 — limited scope (non-critical workloads) with observed support on-call. Phase 2: Expanded alpha (5-8 customers) 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-05 — test autoscaling and monitoring thresholds. Phase 3: Beta (broader customers, opt-in) 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-31 — finalize runbook and playbooks. Phase 4: GA 2026-06-10 — enable self-serve upgrade path and publish documentation. Each phase has clear go/no-go gates: automated smoke tests pass, monitoring alerts within thresholds, CS/SE sign-off, and security checklist completed.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incompatibility between customer infra and new deployment agents — Mitigation: expanded compatibility matrix + preflight detection
Risk: Rolling back complex stateful workloads causes data inconsistency — Mitigation: require snapshots and explicit customer opt-in for stateful rollouts in pilot
Risk: Insufficient telemetry to detect subtle regressions — Mitigation: additional tracing hooks and two new dashboard panels instrumented before alpha
Risk: SLA and support load spike during Beta — Mitigation: dedicated on-call rotations and temporary increase in Solutions Eng coverage
